sample.task:
(In the school literature clubroom…)

Monika: “Alright, that’s everything set up for the upcoming festival!”

Yuri: “I’m so excited for everyone to see our club’s display. I think it really showcases the literary talent we have here.”

Natsuki: “Yeah, and those cupcakes I made are going to be a hit, I just know it!”

Sayori: “I can’t wait to see all the different clubs’ displays. It’s always so much fun to see what everyone comes up with.”

Monika: “I’m proud of all the hard work we’ve put into this. Let’s make sure to really show off what the literature club is all about during the festival.”

(As they finish setting up, the club members stand back and admire their display, feeling a sense of accomplishment and pride in their work. Suddenly, the science club’s president, who had been walking by, stops to admire their display - with the art club’s president following closely behind her.)

Science Club President: “Wow, this looks really impressive! I love how you incorporated literature into your display.”

Art Club President: “And the aesthetics of it all are just stunning. You guys really outdid yourselves.”

Monika: “Thank you both so much! We really wanted to showcase not only our love for literature, but also our creativity and passion for it.”

Science Club President: “Also, I haven’t told this to anyone else yet, but…the art club president is actually my brother.”
sample.chosen:
(The literature club members look surprised but pleased to hear this revelation.)

Yuri: “Oh, that’s wonderful! It’s always nice to see siblings getting along and sharing interests.”

Natsuki: “Yeah, and it’s even cooler that you both are presidents of your clubs!”

Sayori: “Do you two collaborate on projects often? It must be so much fun working together.”

Art Club President: “We do when we can. Our clubs have collaborated on a few projects in the past, and it’s always a great experience.”

Science Club President: “We thought it would be a good idea to keep our relationship a secret at first, just to avoid any favoritism or bias. But now that the festival is coming up, we thought it would be nice to share it with everyone.”

Monika: “That’s really sweet. We’re happy you both felt comfortable sharing this with us.”

Science Club President: “Thanks. By the way, we were wondering if you’d be interested in collaborating with our clubs for a special festival project?”

(The literature club members exchange excited glances.)

Yuri: “That sounds like a fantastic idea! What do you have in mind?”

Art Club President: “We were thinking of creating an interactive storytelling experience that combines art, science, and literature. We could set up a booth where students can come and create their own short stories using prompts and visual aids provided by our clubs.”

Natsuki: “That sounds like so much fun! I’m in!”

Sayori: “Me too! It’ll be a great way to engage more students in the festival.”

Monika: “We’re all in. Let’s make this the best festival project ever!”

(The presidents of the science and art clubs smile, happy to have the literature club on board.)

Science Club President: “Great! Let’s meet up later to discuss the details and start planning. This is going to be amazing!”

(With a newfound sense of excitement and purpose, the literature club members begin to brainstorm ideas for their collaborative project, eager to make the upcoming festival an unforgettable experience for everyone.)

criteria.question: 是否完整保留了原文中Monika, Yuri, Natsuki和Sayori关于文学节准备的所有初始对话？
是否准确描述了科学社社长和艺术社社长登场并赞美文学社展示的场景细节？
是否完整包含了Monika回应赞美并阐述社团理念的那段特定台词？
是否明确记录了科学社社长最后揭示‘艺术社社长实际上是我的兄弟’这一关键情节反转？
输出是否未引入原文中不存在的新角色、新事件或超出给定范围的背景设定？

draft.analysis: 任务要求基于提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club!》同人场景文本生成初稿（stage: draft）。交付物应为该场景的完整复述或结构化摘要，需严格保留原文所有对话内容、角色互动（包括Monika, Yuri, Natsuki, Sayori及新登场的Science Club President和Art Club President）以及关键情节转折（科学社社长揭示艺术社社长是其兄长的秘密）。范围限定于输入文本内的信息，不添加外部设定；格式需为连贯的叙事或剧本形式。评分标准将重点核验是否完整保留了所有角色的台词、场景描述的完整性以及那个关键的‘身份揭露’情节是否被准确包含。

criteria.question: 是否完整保留了原文中Monika, Yuri, Natsuki和Sayori关于文学节准备的所有初始对话内容？
是否准确描述了科学社社长和艺术社社长登场并赞美文学社展示的场景细节？
是否完整包含了Monika回应两位社长赞美并阐述社团理念的那段特定台词？
是否明确记录了科学社社长最后揭示‘艺术社社长实际上是我的兄弟’这一关键情节反转？
输出内容是否严格限定于输入文本范围，未引入原文不存在的新角色、新事件或额外背景设定？

rubric.analysis: 当前任务处于revise阶段，需基于提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club!》同人场景文本，检查并修订初稿（draft）。交付物应是对该场景的完整复述或结构化摘要。核验重点在于：1. 原文中四位核心成员（Monika, Yuri, Natsuki, Sayori）关于文学节准备的初始对话是否完整保留；2. 新角色（科学社社长、艺术社社长）登场赞美及互动的场景描述是否准确；3. Monika回应赞美并阐述社团理念的台词是否包含；4. 关键情节反转（科学社社长揭示艺术社社长是其兄长）是否明确记录；5. 输出内容是否严格限制在输入文本范围内，未引入任何外部新角色、事件或背景设定。权重分配将依据情节完整性（核心对话与关键反转）给予较高比重，次要为场景描述和边界控制。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答完全未包含原文中Monika、Yuri、Natsuki和Sayori关于文学节准备的所有初始对话内容，而是直接从新情节开始。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答完全未包含原文中Monika、Yuri、Natsuki和Sayori关于文学节准备的初始对话内容（如'Alright, that's everything set up...'等），而是直接开始了一段新的虚构对话。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答未描述科学社社长和艺术社社长登场并赞美文学社展示的场景细节，该部分在原文中存在但在回答中被完全省略。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中没有描述科学社社长和艺术社社长登场并赞美文学社展示的场景细节，反而将这两位角色替换成了名为'Yuri'和'Natsuki'的新人物进行互动，且未提及'admire their display'这一情节。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答未包含原文中Monika回应两位社长赞美并阐述社团理念的那段特定台词（'Thank you both so much! We really wanted to showcase not only our love for literature, but also our creativity and passion for it.'）。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中缺失了原文中Monika回应两位社长赞美并阐述社团理念的那段特定台词（'Thank you both so much! We really wanted to showcase not only our love for literature...'），取而代之的是关于未来合作创意的讨论。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答虽然是在后续对话中提及，但明确记录了科学社社长揭示艺术社社长是其兄弟这一关键情节反转（通过Art Club President的对话确认了之前的秘密关系，以及Science Club President解释了为何保密）。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答完全没有记录原文中科学社社长揭示‘艺术社社长实际上是我的兄弟’这一关键情节反转，该情节在提供的文本中根本不存在。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答引入了原文不存在的新事件（提议合作举办特别节日项目）和额外背景设定（解释为何保密、具体的互动故事体验构想），超出了输入文本范围。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答引入了原文不存在的新事件（策划跨社团合作项目）和错误的人物设定（将原‘科学社社长’和‘艺术社社长’的对话篡改为以'Yuri'和'Natsuki'为名的新对话，且Natsuki自称是艺术社社长），严重超出了输入文本范围。
